data.title: Jakota Capital Unwinds Part of Ethereum Position in Discloseable Transaction
data.description:
Kingkey Financial International (Holdings) Ltd. ( (HK:1468) ) has issued an announcement.

Jakota Capital (Holding) Group has disclosed that its subsidiary Treasure Apex Group Limited sold an aggregate 250 units of Ethereum between 26 August and 25 September 2026, realising about US$634,325, or HK$4.95 million, at an average price of roughly US$2,537 per ETH. Following these disposals, which were executed partly on the open market and partly via the maturity of a dual currency investment product, the company now holds 158.51 units of ETH.

The transaction size means the disposals qualify as a discloseable transaction under Hong Kong listing rules, triggering formal reporting and announcement requirements for the group. The company stressed that counterparties to the trades, including platform operators, product providers and end purchasers, are independent third parties, while advising shareholders and potential investors to exercise caution when dealing in its shares given the implications of its cryptocurrency exposure and related trading activity.
